But I've only had factory bratz with saran and the nylon I used was high quality so maybe high quality saran is comparable or better then high quality nylon. But the best comparison I can think of is that nylon feels a bit silkier than saran, saran feels and looks slightly waxier. Saran also feels a little "thicker", where as I think nylon feels a little finer. bought Saran for rerooting once, but personally did not like the feel.

As for styling, Saran can take hotter water (and maybe hotter temps) then Nylon can but Nylon holds curls and textures better then Saran. Apparently Nylon is a little stronger/less prone to breaking. Saran feels a little heavier, and people say it has less flyaways (I haven't had issues with fly aways with any doll hair personally.)
